description.zh: 截图、标注、贴图、长截图、识别文字、录屏和演示白板
description.en: Screenshots, annotations, pins, long screenshots, text recognition, screen recording and a presentation whiteboard

notes.zh: 长截图可以横着截：左右滚动的内容（宽表格、时间轴）拼成一张宽图，面板上的“竖向/横向”按钮切换，开始时也会自己判断方向。权限不变。
notes.en: Sideways long screenshots: content that scrolls left and right (wide tables, timelines) comes out as one wide picture; the panel's Vertical/Horizontal button turns it, and it picks the direction by itself at the start. Permissions unchanged.
